statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2024-0449 is an informational notice that the unsafe-libyaml crate is unmaintained (repository archived 2024-03-25) and names no vulnerability and no patched release beyond 0.2.11. It comes into ddtrace's Rust extension through serde_yaml 0.9.34, which libdatadog's library-config crate uses. Replacing it needs an upstream libdatadog change.

RustSec RUSTSEC-2024-0449 is an unmaintained-crate advisory: the upstream repository was archived in March 2024 and crates.io lists no patched release beyond 0.2.11. The crate remains a transitive dependency of the apollo-mcp-server binary compiled into this image. Clearing it requires upstream dependency migrations (for example moving off serde_yaml-style YAML stacks that pull unsafe-libyaml), which is owned by the apollo-mcp-server package rebuild rather than a lockfile-only precise bump.

RustSec lists no fixed release for unsafe-libyaml 0.2.11. The crate is bundled inside py-rattler 0.26.0, which is the newest build installable with conda-rattler-solver 0.2.0 (that solver requires py-rattler below 0.27.0). py-rattler 0.27.0 is published on conda-forge but cannot be installed until a newer conda-rattler-solver release allows it.

RUSTSEC-2024-0449 reports that unsafe-libyaml is archived and unmaintained after its c2rust translation of libyaml, with no patched releases beyond 0.2.11. Milvus ships it transitively through serde_yaml in the embedded Tantivy binding Cargo graph compiled into the milvus Debian packages this image installs. Replacing it requires upstream dependency migrations to a maintained safe-Rust YAML stack and a package rebuild; that work remains under evaluation. See https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2024-0449.html
